_comment: Default intent definitions — used when workspace has no event_dictionary configured with intents. PM can override per-workspace via the admin UI (event_dictionary column). Workspace intents always take priority over these defaults.

active_user.description: Any user who opened the app or had a session (most common event, highest volume)

activated_user.description: User who completed the activation milestone — first value moment or onboarding completion

retained_user.description: User who returned after their first session — second visit or repeat engagement
